image-segmentation.label: OneFormer mode
image-segmentation.help: OneFormer trains all three heads on one checkpoint. Pick semantic for one mask per class, instance for one mask per object, panoptic for both stuff and things.

image-segmentation.label: Overlay opacity
image-segmentation.help: Alpha of the mask overlay composited onto the image (0-255).

image-segmentation.label: Legend min coverage %
image-segmentation.help: Hide classes covering less than this percent of the image from the legend.

image-segmentation.label: Export individual masks
image-segmentation.help: Include mask images in the result.

mask-generation.label: Points per batch
mask-generation.help: Auto mode only: higher = finer grid of prompt points, slower run.

mask-generation.label: Max masks
mask-generation.help: Auto mode only: cap on returned regions.

mask-generation.label: Min mask %
mask-generation.help: Auto mode only: discard masks covering less than this percent of the image.

mask-generation.label: Export individual masks
mask-generation.help: Include mask images in the result.

object-detection.label: Score threshold
object-detection.help: Drop detections below this confidence. Lower = more boxes, more noise.

object-detection.label: NMS IoU
object-detection.help: IoU for non-max suppression. Higher keeps more overlapping boxes.

image-classification.label: Top-K labels
image-classification.help: How many labels to return, ranked by score.

image-to-text.label: Max new tokens
image-to-text.help: Upper bound on the caption / answer length.

image-to-text.label: Sample (random)
image-to-text.help: Off â†’ greedy. On â†’ sampled generation using temperature / top_p.

image-to-text.label: Temperature
image-to-text.help: Only applies when Sample is on.

image-to-text.label: Top-p
image-to-text.help: Only applies when Sample is on.

depth-estimation.label: Invert (near = warm)
depth-estimation.help: Flip the colormap. Some models predict inverse depth. Toggle if near and far look swapped.

depth-estimation.label: Blend with original
depth-estimation.help: Alpha-blend the colored depth back onto the source image so geometry stays visible.

document-question-answering.label: Top-K answers
document-question-answering.help: Return multiple candidate answers ranked by score (extractive models only).

zero-shot-object-detection.label: Score threshold
zero-shot-object-detection.help: Drop detections below this confidence. Zero-shot models usually need a much lower threshold than closed-set detectors.

zero-shot-object-detection.label: NMS IoU
zero-shot-object-detection.help: IoU for non-max suppression. Higher keeps more overlapping boxes.

image-text-to-text.label: Sample (random)
image-text-to-text.help: Off â†’ greedy. On â†’ sampled generation.

image-text-to-text.label: Temperature
image-text-to-text.help: Only applies when Sample is on.

image-text-to-text.label: Top-p
image-text-to-text.help: Only applies when Sample is on.

image-text-to-text.label: Florence-2 task
image-text-to-text.help: Florence-2 routes behavior via task tokens. Some tokens (CAPTION_TO_PHRASE_GROUNDING, REFERRING_EXPRESSION_SEGMENTATION, OPEN_VOCABULARY_DETECTION) also use the Prompt field as the phrase/expression to ground.

automatic-speech-recognition.label: Whisper mode
automatic-speech-recognition.help: Translate forces output to English regardless of source language. Whisper-only.

automatic-speech-recognition.label: Chunk length (s)
automatic-speech-recognition.help: Whisper's 30s context window. Only used for long-audio (>30s) variant.

automatic-speech-recognition.label: Stride length (s)
automatic-speech-recognition.help: Overlap between chunks. Helps stitch words across boundaries.

automatic-speech-recognition.label: Return timestamps
automatic-speech-recognition.help: Attach per-segment (or per-word) timestamps in the output.

text-to-speech.label: Speaker index
text-to-speech.help: SpeechT5 only. The CMU-Arctic dataset has 7931 x-vectors (0-7930). 7306 is the HF default (clear female voice). Try other indices for different speakers.

text-to-image.label: Inference steps
text-to-image.help: More steps â†’ higher quality, linearly slower. 20-30 is a sweet spot for most SDXL / SD models; FLUX works at 4-8.

text-to-image.label: Guidance scale
text-to-image.help: Classifier-free guidance. Higher = stricter prompt adherence, less diversity.

text-to-image.label: Negative prompt
text-to-image.help: Things to steer AWAY from. e.g. "blurry, extra fingers, watermark".

text-to-image.label: Seed
text-to-image.help: Use the same seed and parameters to reproduce a run on the same runtime.

image-to-image.label: Strength
image-to-image.help: How much to transform: 0 = original image unchanged, 1 = fully regenerated from prompt.

image-to-image.label: Inference steps
image-to-image.help: More steps â†’ higher quality, linearly slower.

image-to-image.label: Guidance scale
image-to-image.help: Classifier-free guidance. Higher = stricter prompt adherence.

image-to-image.label: Seed
image-to-image.help: Use the same seed and parameters to reproduce a run on the same runtime.

text-generation.label: Max new tokens
text-generation.help: Upper bound on generated tokens. Truncates long outputs. Raise if answers are cut off.

text-generation.label: Sample (random)
text-generation.help: Off â†’ greedy (deterministic). On â†’ uses temperature / top_p / top_k.

text-generation.label: Temperature
text-generation.help: Higher = more creative. Only applies when Sample is on.

text-generation.label: Top-p
text-generation.help: Nucleus sampling. Only applies when Sample is on.

text-generation.label: Top-k
text-generation.help: 0 disables top-k. Only applies when Sample is on.

text2text-generation.label: Max new tokens
text2text-generation.help: Upper bound on generated tokens. Truncates long outputs. Raise if answers are cut off.

text2text-generation.label: Sample (random)
text2text-generation.help: Off â†’ greedy (deterministic). On â†’ uses temperature / top_p / top_k.

text2text-generation.label: Temperature
text2text-generation.help: Higher = more creative. Only applies when Sample is on.

text2text-generation.label: Top-p
text2text-generation.help: Nucleus sampling. Only applies when Sample is on.

text2text-generation.label: Top-k
text2text-generation.help: 0 disables top-k. Only applies when Sample is on.

translation.label: Sample (random)

translation.label: Temperature

translation.label: Top-p
translation.help: Nucleus sampling. Only applies when Sample is on.

translation.label: Top-k
translation.help: 0 disables top-k. Only applies when Sample is on.

translation.label: Source language
translation.help: NLLB and M2M-100 only. NLLB codes: "eng_Latn", "fra_Latn", "hin_Deva". M2M-100 codes: "en", "fr". Leave empty for Marian (fixed-pair).

translation.label: Target language
translation.help: Same format as source. Check the model card for valid codes.

summarization.label: Max new tokens
summarization.help: Upper bound on generated tokens. Truncates long outputs. Raise if answers are cut off.

summarization.label: Sample (random)
summarization.help: Off â†’ greedy (deterministic). On â†’ uses temperature / top_p / top_k.

summarization.label: Temperature
summarization.help: Higher = more creative. Only applies when Sample is on.

summarization.label: Top-p
summarization.help: Nucleus sampling. Only applies when Sample is on.

summarization.label: Top-k
summarization.help: 0 disables top-k. Only applies when Sample is on.

feature-extraction.label: Normalize (unit length)
feature-extraction.help: L2-normalize the vector so cosine similarity is a plain dot product. Cosine similarity then reduces to a plain dot product.

feature-extraction.label: Dimensions
feature-extraction.help: Truncate to the first N dimensions (Matryoshka models like nomic-embed / text-embedding-3). 0 = full size.

sentence-similarity.label: Normalize (unit length)
sentence-similarity.help: L2-normalize the vector so cosine similarity is a plain dot product. Cosine similarity then reduces to a plain dot product.

sentence-similarity.label: Dimensions
sentence-similarity.help: Truncate to the first N dimensions (Matryoshka models like nomic-embed / text-embedding-3). 0 = full size.

inpainting.label: Strength
inpainting.help: How much to transform: 0 = original image unchanged, 1 = fully regenerated from prompt.

inpainting.label: Inference steps
inpainting.help: More steps â†’ higher quality, linearly slower.

inpainting.label: Guidance scale
inpainting.help: Classifier-free guidance. Higher = stricter prompt adherence.

inpainting.label: Seed
inpainting.help: Use the same seed and parameters to reproduce a run on the same runtime.
